summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Rust memvid sidecar (port 3031) and Python FastAPI integration. 14/15 tests passed. All core flows work: ingest, list, BM25 retrieve, delete, persistence across restarts, TTL maintain, and end-to-end /api/hca/run.

minor.issue: Deleting a non-existent memory_id returns 200 instead of 404. Sidecar treats delete as idempotent — no error when ID not found.

action_items: MINOR: In sidecar DELETE /memory/:id — return 404 when the memory_id does not exist in the store (currently returns 200 silently).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /health returns 404 — no health route is registered in main.rs. Consider adding a simple /health endpoint so supervisor/k8s can use it for liveness checks.
IngestResponse.memory_id is Option<String> — it can be null if Tantivy indexing fails silently. Consider returning a 500 instead.
DELETE idempotency: returning 200 for non-existent IDs is unusual; 404 is the REST convention unless idempotency is intentional.
seed_data_creation: Test memories prefixed with TEST_ were ingested and cleaned up during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All sidecar endpoints use field names: raw_text (ingest), query_text (retrieve), hits (retrieve response), memory_id (ingest response). /api/hca/run requires 'goal' field. Persistence tests verify WAL survives supervisorctl restart. One minor issue: DELETE non-existent ID returns 200.
